name: degeneracy_verdicts_occupancy
caption: Per-trajectory degeneracy verdicts for the 28-cell occupancy grid reused in Stage 6 (24 S5.1 + 4 S2.2 raw T=0.3 physics/surreal). Thresholds 0.083 / late Jaccard 0.0122 were not moved. Degenerate rows are kept.
alt_text: Per-trajectory degeneracy verdicts for the 28-cell occupancy grid reused in Stage 6 (24 S5.1 + 4 S2.2 raw T=0.3 physics/surreal). Thresholds 0.083 / late Jaccard 0.0122 were not moved. Degenerate rows are kept.
limitations: Degeneracy is a surface-form measure. A trajectory can be lexically varied and still semantically static. Stage 6 did not retune the bar.
